meta.title: A counter offer creates one task per bid, due at the evaluation end, and the due date follows extensions
gaps: The counter-offer request is not specified and no operation or library case creates a counter offer on a bid.
No setup recipe creates a second round with a participant review window.
There is no operation for resolving a counter offer, deleting a bid, or reading the resulting task.
Task count, evaluation-end due date, extension behavior, and the expected error after bid deletion cannot be asserted with the available read-back fields.
